inScope: Register a visitor's initial adoption interest from a public animal profile for later staff handling.
Define a minimal boundary for applicant data that does not expose it through public animal-profile responses.
Record proposed use of AVAILABLE and the need to decide an explicit status-transition policy.
outOfScope: Applicant screening, authentication, automatic approval, and the complete adoption process.
Implemented staff-review UI or staff-review API.
A settled consent, data-retention, duplicate-interest, or privacy policy.

assumptions: Later staff handling will require a private operational capability, but its interface and authorization model are not defined in the supplied evidence.
An initial-interest submission may require applicant data; the exact fields and their handling require validation.
AVAILABLE can be used as an eligibility condition for accepting initial interest, subject to a proposed explicit transition policy rather than a claimed current rule.

alternatives.description: Keep the existing public interest link as future-only navigation and defer all interest registration until the later adoption prototype.
alternatives.consequence: Avoids introducing applicant data before privacy and operational policies are validated, but does not satisfy the concern of allowing a visitor to register initial interest now.

alternatives.description: Add a narrow initial-interest capability: a public animal-profile interaction submits a minimal adoption-interest request to a dedicated application boundary, persisted separately from public Animal responses for later staff handling.
alternatives.consequence: Meets the incremental concern while keeping applicant data outside public profile responses; it requires future validation of consent, retention, duplicates, privacy, staff handling, and status-transition policy.

selectedOption.rationale: A dedicated, minimal adoption-interest boundary addresses the requested visitor action without implementing screening, authentication, approval, or the complete adoption process. It preserves framework-independent domain responsibilities and separates applicant data from public Animal responses.

webContext.interactionFlow: On a public animal detail page, a visitor initiates interest registration and submits an initial-interest request for that animal. The request is handled by a dedicated application/API boundary and retained for later staff handling; no staff-review interface is proposed as implemented.
boundaries: The public animal detail page currently contains a future-oriented interest link but no form.
The current Animals API has no adoption-interest endpoint.
Applicant data, if introduced, must remain outside public animal-profile responses.
Domain concepts must remain independent of framework concerns.
webContext.dataVisibility: Public animal-profile responses must not return applicant data. Any submitted applicant data requires a separate non-public boundary for later staff handling.
qualityAttributes: Privacy requires validation before applicant-data handling is finalized.
Traceability requires documenting relevant architectural changes.
Incremental delivery limits the capability to initial interest only.

domainRules.rule: Proposed rule: initial interest may be accepted only when the Animal status is AVAILABLE; this is a proposed eligibility condition, not a current implemented rule.
An explicit Animal status-transition policy is required before any proposal changes status as part of interest registration; no current transition policy is encoded.
Initial interest must not be represented as screening, automatic approval, or completion of adoption.

validation: Define consent language and the lawful/privacy handling requirements for applicant data.
Define retention and deletion policy for initial-interest records.
Define duplicate-interest policy, including repeated submissions for the same animal.
Validate the minimal applicant-data fields needed for later staff handling.
Validate the private staff-handling boundary and any future authorization approach.
Decide whether an AVAILABLE animal remains AVAILABLE after interest submission or whether a future explicit transition policy changes status.
Validate API input validation requirements for the new request boundary.
documentationUpdates: Create a versioned ADR describing the initial-interest boundary, public-data visibility constraint, and deferred decisions.
Update the functional scope document to add initial interest and explicitly retain screening, authentication, approval, and complete adoption as out of scope.
Update the architecture document to describe the new application/domain/infrastructure responsibilities if implemented.
Update the domain diagram with AdoptionInterest and its relationship to Animal as a proposed increment.
Update reusable prompts to reflect the initial-interest scope and unresolved privacy and status-policy validations.
